state_binding.freshness: Fresh live status and nested component inventory were re-read during the PLAN-0010 source-exhaustion review; source-search results are project-state observations, not new admitted mechanical evidence.

intent: Enter an explicit mechanism-engineering / Proof-of-Principle phase for bottle capture and rotation. Define a mechanism-independent POP acceptance envelope, then formulate and test bounded candidate architectures against the same support/restraint, rotation, label-transfer, reaction-path, motion, release, and clearance obligations. Candidate testing is diagnostic and does not constitute final mechanism selection or mechanical acceptance.

projected_steps.title: Freeze the mechanism-independent POP acceptance envelope before creating or moving candidate geometry
expected_outputs: D48 bottle/product geometry binding and allowed variation explicitly sourced or left unresolved
required restrained/permitted bottle DOF by INDEXED, CAPTURE, LABEL_TRANSFER, WRAP and RELEASE states
minimum functional support/contact roles and wrap-axis requirement
entry/capture/release sequencing obligations
success/failure observables for maintained contact, restraint, rotation, reaction path and clearance
unknown friction, preload, force, stiffness and tolerance inputs preserved as MEASUREMENT_REQUIRED rather than guessed

projected_steps.title: Define candidate mechanism contracts without ranking or selecting a production design
expected_outputs: candidate owner identity and architecture class
open-to-capture-to-release motion law
contact-maintenance method
rotation input and drive/contact separation
reaction support and mounting concept
limits, adjustment and compliance model
Candidate A v43 Prism explicitly retained as project proposal/FITCHECK geometry only

projected_steps.title: Choose the first Proof-of-Principle candidate by diagnostic value, not resemblance or convenience
projected_steps.selection_rule: dependency centrality × discrimination power × evidence confidence × unresolved relevance ÷ cost
expected_outputs: explicit reason for which candidate is tested first
which competing hypotheses the test can discriminate
required deterministic observations and measurements
clear statement that POP test priority is not final mechanism preference

projected_steps.title: Preflight a bounded deterministic CAD POP representation for the selected test candidate
expected_outputs: exact component identities and source classification
open/capture/release state transforms or constrained motion definition
whole-body interference/clearance test plan
contact/tangency and restraint checks
reaction-path and mounting checks
rollback/preservation strategy that does not overwrite v43
projected_steps.authorization_boundary: Any SOLIDWORKS write remains outside this ledger plan and requires separate explicit authorization plus fresh preflight.

projected_steps.title: Run representative Proof-of-Principle verification only after deterministic preflight
expected_outputs: state-by-state evidence for entry, capture, wrap, release and neighbor clearance
negative evidence and disproven candidate assumptions recorded
representative physical-product trial requirements identified for any behavior CAD cannot establish
mechanical acceptance remains separately gated
projected_steps.authorization_boundary: This ledger step authorizes verification planning/read-only evidence only; any SOLIDWORKS write requires separate explicit authorization and is not granted here.

source_discovery_reopen_rule: Any new authoritative OEM/integrator source that names the actual product-centering owner reopens source binding and is evaluated before further candidate commitment.
acceptance_gate: No candidate progresses because it looks plausible in a static pose. A POP candidate must have explicit closure/release ownership, maintained contact, rotation input, reaction support, limits, reachable-state clearance, and label-transfer coherence. POP success still does not equal mechanically accepted production geometry.
no_write_boundary: This plan authorizes planning, source review, calculations and read-only CAD inspection only. No SOLIDWORKS geometry creation, transform, mate, insertion, suppression change, rebuild or save is authorized without a separate explicit write authorization and fresh preflight.

progress.note: v43 PRISM selected only as the first diagnostic POP candidate because it has the strongest live evidence basis and lowest bounded test cost for resolving the current closure/contact-maintenance frontier; this is not a production mechanism ranking or preference.
